mechanism.claim: Periodic algorithmic trading concentrates informative order flow at cryptocurrency quarter-hour openings. When at least four of six liquid alt perpetuals share one completed first-five-minute aggressive quote-imbalance sign and the cross-contract imbalance strength is unusually large, the common alt demand shock should propagate into BTC over the next six hours during elevated BTC variation.
mechanism.side: strict majority sign of six alt opening-window aggressive quote imbalances; BTC order flow and return direction are never inputs

external_basis.paper: The Quarter-Hour Effect: Periodic Algorithmic Trading and Return Predictability in Cryptocurrency Futures
external_basis.reported_result: quarter-hour opening order imbalance across six Binance perpetual contracts forecasts four-to-twelve-hour returns
external_basis.adaptation: cross-contract alt consensus mapped once to BTC under a causal high-variation gate

mechanism.why_distinct: HVQHOFR and QHOIR used BTC's own quarter-hour imbalance and failed Gross9 novelty. HVCAQF excludes BTC imbalance entirely and requires a six-alt cross-contract majority plus median strength tail; cross-alt flow candidates aggregate multi-hour blocks without quarter-hour phase. It reuses no prior event set, threshold, side, control or outcome fit.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC trailing completed twenty-four-hour variation must occupy its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: cross-contract consensus onsets at quarter-hour openings with six-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.opening_window: five exact bars_binance one-minute rows [Q,Q+5m) independently for each alt
features.normalized_imbalance: sum(2*taker_buy_quote_asset_volume-quote_asset_volume)/sum(quote_asset_volume), finite strict nonzero with positive denominator
features.consensus: at least four of six strict imbalance signs share one direction; 3-3 split rejects
features.consensus_strength: median absolute normalized imbalance of only the direction-confirming alts, finite strict positive
features.strength_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 source-valid quarter-hours, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC five-minute open-to-close log returns over the 288 completed bars [Q-24h,Q)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 source-valid quarter-hours, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: consensus plus both causal ranks pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid quarter-hour ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.feature_available: Q+5m after all opening-window rows complete
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT perpetual Q+10m open, one full five-minute bar after feature availability
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp and 10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, phase, opening window, imbalance, breadth, strength, history, rank, variation, side, delay, hold, clock, subset, source or control repair
